description: Answers: where does my draft claim something without showing why? Takes the text of your draft (up to 4000 characters) and splits it into sentences. Word rules, no AI, no web search: a number without a source, a forecast stated as fact, vague authority ('experts say'), 'now/latest' without a date or with an old year, a quote without a speaker, 'first' without a definition, an extraordinary claim without a source, 'always/never', pressure to act with money, a false attribution to Orb Studio. Returns risk (low / medium / high), the flagged sentences with their flags, and the fixes to make first. 'no_rule_fired' means no rule fired, not that a sentence is true. For one claim use check_claim; for outlet counts use check_headline.
name: audit_draft
title: Audit your own draft answer before sending: which sentences state something with no visible basis
